resources.string: Android 10 and newer block automatic Wi-Fi changes for this app. Granting permissions will not enable this action. Change Wi-Fi in system settings instead.
Android 13 and newer block automatic Bluetooth changes for this app. Nearby devices permission does not remove this restriction. Change Bluetooth in system settings instead.
On Android 15 and newer, this action controls only the app’s own Do Not Disturb rule. Other active modes can keep Do Not Disturb on after this action turns it off.
Taking screenshots requires Android 11 or newer. This action cannot capture the screen on this device, even with accessibility access.
Android 10 and older have no recoverable picture bin. On this device, choosing “Move to the bin” deletes the picture permanently.
